title: Westminster Fellowship, Assembly Hall Crowd - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A view from the back of a gymnasium or auditorium filled with seated attendees during the Westminster Fellowship National Assembly in July 1957. Above the center aisle hangs a basketball goal, while the illuminated stage at the far end features the assembly banner and a large silhouette map of the United States. Westminster Fellowship was the prominent youth ministry movement of the Presbyterian Church in the post-WWII era.
